name: UI：F88 链路创建与环节管理
description: 新建链路，添加环节（首图生图、首图审核），验证链路编排界面正确渲染，保存刷新验证持久化。

steps.description: 验证链路列表页已加载
等待新建链路页面/弹窗

steps.expression: (() => { const inputs = document.querySelectorAll('input'); for (const input of inputs) { if (input.placeholder && (input.placeholder.includes('链路') || input.placeholder.includes('名称'))) { const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(input, '自动化测试-组合链路'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true})); return { ok: true, placeholder: input.placeholder }; } } return { ok: false, inputCount: inputs.length }; })()

(() => { const ta = document.querySelectorAll('textarea'); for (const t of ta) { t.focus(); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLTextAreaElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(t, '自动化测试链路-验证环节管理'); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true})); return { ok: true }; } return { ok: false }; })()

(() => { const btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); for (const b of btns) { const txt = b.textContent.replace(/\s/g, ''); if ((txt === '确定' || txt === '创建' || txt === '保存' || txt.includes('提交')) && b.offsetHeight > 0 && !b.disabled) { b.click(); return { ok: true, text: b.textContent.trim() }; } } return { ok: false }; })()
(() => { const text = document.body.innerText; return { hasAddStep: text.includes('添加环节'), hasDesc: text.includes('链路说明'), url: window.location.href }; })()

(() => { const btns = document.querySelectorAll('button'); for (const b of btns) { if (b.textContent.replace(/\s/g, '').includes('添加环节') && b.offsetHeight > 0) { b.click(); return { ok: true }; } } return { ok: false }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer-open'); const target = modal || drawer; if (!target) return { type: 'none' }; const inputs = target.querySelectorAll('input, select, textarea'); return { type: modal ? 'modal' : 'drawer', inputCount: inputs.length, text: target.innerText.substring(0, 300) }; })()
